note: Written by the same author (an AI assistant) that wrote the Sentinel rules, after the rules were frozen, without tuning the rules to it. It is a second check, not an independent test. A person who did not write the rules must label a real sample before any detection rate is published (T6.05). Labels are the author's judgement of what a careful person would call a scam (1) or a genuine message (0).
